budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Cemetery Commission requested ARPA funding of $350K for restoration of the North Cemetery boundaries.
budget_items.quote: request: $350k for restoration of north cemetery boundaries.

budget_items.topic: Permanent field-stone wall versus hemlock hedges
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The preferred permanent New England Rustic Field-Stone Wall was estimated at a range of approximately $288K to $388K.
budget_items.quote: permanent new england rustic field-stone wall - estimated range at approximately $288k to $388k,

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The replacement cost of hemlock hedges was estimated at approximately $185K.
budget_items.quote: replacement cost of hemlock hedges are estimated at approximately $185k.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: One year of watering for the newly planted trees was estimated at $3K, with three seasons of watering needed.
budget_items.quote: one year of watering will cost the cemetery commission and dpw an estimated $3k.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A well to be drilled at North Cemetery was estimated at $15K or more, excluding pump, piping and electricity.
budget_items.quote: additional cost of $15k or more for a well to be drilled.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: DPW put storm-related costs at approximately $24,000, forwarded to the state senator's office for relief funding.
budget_items.quote: put together an estimate of approximately $24,000 in costs attributed to this storm

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The town was advised to budget a 10% increase for active health plans for FY25 and expect 8-10% annual increases over the next five years; the retiree renewal for calendar 2024 is estimated at 6%.
budget_items.quote: we should budget 10% for active plans for fy25 and expect 8-10% increases in health insurance rates each year over the next five years.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The third quarter preliminary tax installment cannot exceed the first quarter preliminary installment.
budget_items.quote: third quarter preliminary tax installment cannot be more than the amount of the first quarter preliminary tax

budget_items.topic: Funds available versus cost of cemetery project
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Board questions addressed the high cost of the cemetery project compared with the ARPA funding remaining.
budget_items.quote: as well as the high cost of the project versus what arpa funding remains.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Facilities Director will seek quotes to repair the TC Passios roof in phases; a warrant article is a placeholder for the Special Town Meeting.
budget_items.quote: he is going to seek quotes to repair that roof in phases.
